answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1659 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pulse. The hollow index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the bridge queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Each impostor pays 1 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
